---
title: "Vethara"
subtitle: "Expansion Era (~15,100–15,500 SD)"
---


Established Expansion Era colony hub and departure world for the CGSS Threshold. Founded approximately 15,100 SD — roughly 400 years before the events of "The Threshold." Sagan-Kim Tier 6 (highly habitable, near-Earth analogue).

## Overview

Vethara is old enough to have cities, universities, a functioning industrial base, and the political infrastructure of a proto-House seat. It is young enough that most residents can name the generation of their family that first colonized it. This combination — stability without forgetting what arrival cost — makes Vethara a culturally significant departure point. Colonists who board ships on Vethara's orbital ring are the children and grandchildren of colonists themselves. They know the mathematics of the journey. They have heard the stories.

Vethara is the operational base for House Varen's colonial expansion program. The CGSS maintains a major certification office and orbital station here — the Threshold departed from Vethara Station.

## Physical Characteristics

Vethara orbits Tau Ceti — a G8 main-sequence star 11.9 light-years from Sol, the nearest solitary sun of Sol's own kind and one of the `C-06` systems the Exodus considered worth a ship. Slightly smaller and cooler than Sol. Vethara is Tier 6: comfortable, hospitable, requiring minimal adaptation. Earth-analogue biology partially established through early terraforming by second-generation colony ships. The landscape is a patchwork of native alien ecosystems and Earth-derived cultivated zones — most Vetharans consider both "theirs."

## Cultural Notes

Vetharans have a specific relationship with departure. Every third or fourth family in the major cities has a member who left on a colony ship and will never return — the 30-year voyage is one-way by any practical measure. Departure ceremonies are significant social rituals. The orbital ring is permanently visible from the surface and carries cultural weight beyond its engineering function.

Mara Solis grew up on Vethara. Her parents were first-generation settlers. She boarded the Threshold knowing exactly what she was leaving and precisely what she hoped Aranda could become.
